_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Agay-ayam a Snake iti {width}×{height} a grid.
Kontrolenyo ti snake {player_id}. Mabalin a panaggunay: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (wenno w/s/a/d).
Obhetibo: agbiag ti kaatiddogan wenno agbalin a kaatiddogan ken makagun-od ti kangatuan a puntos (limitasyon ti panaggunay {max_turns} a panaggunay).

game_action.invalid_death: Natay ni Serpente {player_id} gapu iti saan a maitutop nga iyaakar.

outcome.survived_win: Nagbiag ti agay-ayam {player_id}; natay amin dagiti dadduma.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Agpapada a natay amin dagiti uleg.
outcome.outlived: Ti Player ti nakalasat kadagiti amin a dadduma.
outcome.turn_limit: Naabot ti limitasion iti panagbueltana - mangabak ti kalaingan a puntos.
